text: こんな　いわやまに　いたら　いわが　うえから　ゴロゴロ　おちてきて　ギャー！

structure.jp: こんな　いわやまに　いたら
structure.en: if you're in a rocky mountain like this

structure.jp: いわが　うえから　ゴロゴロ　おちてきて
structure.en: rocks come tumbling down from above, and

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. いたら = 'if you are (here)'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる says the action moves toward the speaker. おちてきて = 'come falling down (at you), and'.
